authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full bhartṛ husband article gives Pali bhattā/bhattāraṁ, Assamese bhatār, Bengali bhātār and Bihari bhatār husband. Hajong batar/batʰar husband match the eastern bhatār family; lack or shifted position of aspiration and vowel length are retained as survey qualifications. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Extended bʰʌtaɾʌs and batevu are excluded pending morphology. Exact response: batar.
